notes_for_editor: Very thin. The only lookout-specific source is the Forest Lookouts page: an agency header and a 1916 newspaper item that calls the place a lookout camp, which may not mean a tower. The page also cites a 1915 state forester report and a 1919 entry; those appear only in search snippets, not in a readable cache, so they are not used. Ogle Mountain Mine (DOGAMI and mining-history pages) is a separate gold mine and is not used. The Karl-Helser trip report is cited for the route only; it does not establish ownership or public access. The brief's agency was null; facts.agency comes from the Forest Lookouts header. The record's county (Clackamas) agrees with the Forest Lookouts index. Ogle Mountain is not on the firelookout.org Oregon list, so no NHLR or FFLOS entry was found.
